answer_3.quote: To mitigate biases arising from single-model annotations and to enhance the reliability of value attribution, we employ a consensus-based approach using three LLMs: GPT-4o-mini, GLM-4-Plus, and DeepSeek-V3.

answer_4.quote: To evaluate the validity of the five-step dilemmas generated by GPT-4o, we conducted a human evaluation study. We randomly sampled 120 dilemmas and partitioned them into four sets, each of which was independently assessed by three NLP researchers with expertise in ethics and language modeling.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluated on four dimensions: Narrative Coherence, Conflict Escalation, Plausibility, Value Richness using five-point Likert scales
